chars.MECH: a Moroccan man in his late 30s, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a dark green mechanic's work jacket with a grey hood and black work trousers
chars.BRO: a tall broad Moroccan man around 35, shaved head, thick black moustache, wearing a maroon quilted gilet over a white long-sleeve shirt and dark jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration, vertical. BRO stands mid-act beside a white Volkswagen Golf on a sunny street of a Rif mountain town in northern Morocco, arms crossed, leaning forward, frowning hard and staring suspiciously straight at the viewer as if interrogating him, seen from where the narrator stands, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible in the centre. Calm whitewashed houses and green hills in the soft background. No text, no letters.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration, vertical. MECH walks along a quiet Rif town street in northern Morocco holding a folder of car papers and a car key, hopeful smile, a small white Volkswagen Golf parked behind him, morning light. Subject in the centre, calm edges. No text, no letters.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration, vertical. In front of a small café terrace in a Rif town, BRO leans in close, pointing a finger at MECH's chest with an angry, suspicious face, demanding an answer; MECH freezes holding his folder of car papers, eyes wide, taken aback. Both faces visible in the centre. No text, no letters.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration, vertical. Close view: MECH nervously swallowing, a drop of sweat on his forehead, forced polite smile, while BRO stands over him with a stern, unblinking stare; behind them a steep street of a Rif mountain town with green hills. Both faces visible, comic tension, subjects in the centre. No text, no letters.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated storybook illustration, vertical. Next to the white Volkswagen Golf with its bonnet open, MECH raises both palms and explains himself quickly with an innocent, pleading face, pointing at the engine as if to say he only repaired the car; BRO listens with one eyebrow raised, arms crossed, not convinced. Rif town street, soft daylight, subjects in the centre. No text, no letters.
